d: Wall Street has suffered a massive AI-driven market meltdown, wiping out nearly $2.5 trillion in market value as fears over US data centre investments and political uncertainty rattle investors. The Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow plunged, while the sell-off spread across Asian markets. But India bucked the global trend, with the Sensex and Nifty staying in positive territory. What's protecting Indian markets? A return of foreign investors, lower exposure to the AI trade and strong large-cap stocks. But rising crude oil prices and market volatility remain key risks.
